propositions: Diagnostic artifacts (findings doc + two reusable parameterized scripts) were committed on impl-10ae-verifier-ctx but not reachable from origin/main, making ticket evidence unverifiable on main.
Three artifacts must be landed unchanged on main as a separate change to establish durable, verifiable record of completion-verifier runaway measurement and budget-anchoring findings.

The completion-verifier runaway loop persists on current main even after recent merges; guard catches it at ~66 requests on certain tickets but does not prevent the underlying excessive tool-call repetition.
Diagnostic scripts are reusable against future step-floor changes (ticket 2948 modifies exactly that parameter) and depend only on stable public surfaces (pai_tools, completion._VERIFY_MIN_STEPS).

Budget-anchoring matrix confirms: step floor 50 (req 25) yields 0 runaways; floor 240 (req 120) and 480 (req 240) both yield runaways caught by recovery, indicating verifier lacks sufficient stopping criterion relative to budget allowance.
